notes.title: THE NEW TIES: SOUL LINK DEMO AND TRAILER IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Check out the new trailer for Ties: Soul Link, which kicks off the launch of the new demo and Kickstarter preview page:

[previewyoutube=E5nLvIp7Zv4;full][/previewyoutube]

These are the highlights of the NEW DEMO:


 Includes various cinematics that will put you in context of the game's exciting story.
 The introduction to the story of Ties: Soul Link, discover the origin of Kiro's adventure through the world of 2097.
 You will be able to test the fire and shield runes from the beginning. 
 Discover the 2 hidden bosses in the first zone.
 The cost has been lowered to the hotel and the bank, that before had a very high cost and could not be tested if you didn't spend some time trying to use/unlock them.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056822/6708af841268129b86408b52eea4fab471325a82.png

You can now enter the preview page of the Kickstarter campaign that is being prepared. Soon we will be telling you more about it and we are sure you want to be the first person to know about it, sign up now and don't miss anything ^^

GET NOTIFIED NOW!
